column3: The Hebrew says the situation was reversed without naming a plan; BSB says their plan was overturned.
The Hebrew says they assembled to send out a hand against those seeking their harm; BSB renders this as an attack.
The Hebrew describes the officials as lifting up the Jews; BSB says they helped them.
The Hebrew describes Mordecai as great in the king’s house and going on becoming great; BSB explicitly speaks of power.
